request.prompt: Image 1 is the reference for hall-1-wide. Image 2 is the reference for clerk-1-front. Cinematic 16:9 anime film still, flat 2D cel-shaded 1980s OVA anime, clean ink linework, hard cel shadows, subtle halftone and film grain, same art style as the reference images. Compose for a 16:9 frame: keep heads and key action away from the top and bottom edges. No text, no letters, no logos anywhere except the '07' patch on the girl's sleeve. Extreme wide high-angle establishing shot of the amber-lit retro-futurist bureau hall exactly as in its reference (beige desks, beige CRTs glowing amber, olive filing cabinets, brass tubes, orange floor lines), the hall stretching endlessly to a vanishing point, thousands of desks, tiny identical short round beige 'Clerk' androids with blank face plates, olive vests and olive sleeve covers working at the desks like dots. Grand, quiet, warm amber.
